name: hyperframes
description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
one_liner: A tool that turns a simple webpage-style description into an actual downloadable video — so an AI can 'write' a video the same way it writes a webpage.
buyer: A course creator or marketing freelancer who needs a steady stream of short branded videos (product intros, ad variants, explainer clips) without hiring a video editor for every single one.
business_use_cases: An e-commerce brand generates dozens of 10-second product-intro video ads with different hooks and prices, testing which one converts best, without touching a video editor.
A course creator turns each lesson's slide deck into a narrated video automatically by describing the layout and letting the tool render the MP4.
A software company auto-generates changelog/release videos every sprint from a templated HTML script, keeping their YouTube channel active with zero editing time.

money_ideas.idea: Build a 'video ads factory' service: businesses submit a product description and get back 10 ready-to-post video ad variants generated through this pipeline.
Offer a done-for-you templated video service for course creators — they fill a form, you render and deliver via this tool.

steal_this: Build a weekend micro-SaaS: a form that takes a product name + 3 bullet points and outputs a 10-second vertical ad video using a couple of the pre-built HyperFrames templates.
